method: The right-hand sweep mirrored: the same 1x1 radial square on a left-hand helix r=10, pitch=3, turns=4. The helix twist makes the Pappus product 80 pi only an approximation, so volume/area/centroid/bbox are frozen from the kernel build; the left chirality mirrors the solid through the y=0 plane, so area/bbox match the right-hand case and the centroid sits on the axis.
